title: 第4章 起飞姿态多少有点小妖娆
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

外界发生的事情暂且打扰不到莱恩。

例如沃特公司因玛德琳的死亡而导致超级七人队管理层混乱一时，公司首席执行官斯坦·埃德加不得不亲自下场。

又或是已经杀死了隐形人，且被沃特公司倒打一耙变成通缉犯的休伊一行人。

至于黑袍纠察队的队长比利…

这倒霉家伙因为之前一心找祖国人报仇而至小队众人落入险境，如今虽然被祖国人放过但又被妻子仍然活着这一现实给打击到快自闭了。

目前正处于失联状态，且不去管他。

总之，不论外界风起云涌，还是暗潮涌动，现在都与莱恩无关。

等到了第二天，他的周围发生了巨大的变化。

“妈妈，今天我没有看到拉姆大叔跑步，苏珊奶奶也没有浇花，还有……”

“人都去哪里了？社区是有什么活动吗？”

还能为什么，当然是因为祖国人已经找到了他，那么这个虚假的楚门世界便再也无法维系下去。

另外昨天总负责人乔尼被带走以后，整个监控小组都处于瘫痪状态了。

母亲贝卡勉强笑笑：“对，他们去旅游了。”

“我也想去～”

莱恩作出一副兴致勃勃的样子：“妈妈，我从未旅游过，我也想和沃特一样，能够去很多地方，认识许多小伙伴。”

贝卡正要说些什么，忽然，一道劲风从天而降。

祖国人哈哈笑着：“那还不简单，你想去哪里我都会带你去。”

“不行！”

贝卡应激一般，想都不想直接一口回绝。

但当她看到莱恩诧异与害怕的目光后，却一下子就反应过来。

她慌张解释：“莱恩，我是说，妈妈将来会带你去的，只是现在还不可以。”

“为什么？”

“因为，呃…对了，你还有钢琴课需要学习。”

“好~吧。”

【日常表演经验值+5】

聊胜于无。

莱恩心中想着，却不妨碍他转头兴奋地望向祖国人。

“爸爸，你会飞，好厉害！”

在贝卡欲言又止的难受表情下，祖国人叉腰得意：“当然，我当然会飞。”

“儿子，其实你也会飞，不如我们今天学习一下怎么飞翔，如何？”

“我也会飞？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

What's happening in the outside world won't bother Ryan for the time being.

For example, Vought's death caused a moment of chaos in the management of the Super Seven, and company CEO Stan Edgar had to step down personally.

Or Huey and his team who have killed the invisible man and been turned into wanted criminals by Walter Company.

As for Billy, the captain of the black robe picket team...

This unlucky guy was bent on seeking revenge from his motherland, which put everyone in the team in danger. Now, although he was spared by his motherland, he was so shocked by the reality that his wife was still alive that he was almost autistic.

He is currently out of contact and ignores him.

In short, regardless of the turmoil outside or the undercurrent, it has nothing to do with Ryan now.

By the next day, great changes had taken place around him.

"Mom, I didn't see Uncle Ram running today, and Grandma Susan didn't water the flowers, and..."

"Where have everyone gone? Are there any activities in the community?"

Why else, of course, it's because the people of the motherland have found him, and then this false Truman world can no longer be maintained.

In addition, after the general manager Johnny was taken away yesterday, the entire monitoring team was paralyzed.

Mother Beka forced a smile: "Yes, they went on a trip."

"I want to go too~"

Ryan looked very interested: "Mom, I have never traveled. I also want to be like Walter, able to go to many places and meet many friends."

Beka was about to say something when suddenly, a strong wind fell from the sky.

The people from the motherland laughed and said: "That's not easy. I will take you wherever you want to go."

"No!"

Beca was so stressed that she refused without even thinking.

But when she saw Ryan's surprised and frightened look, she immediately reacted.

She explained in a panic: "Ryan, I mean, mom will take you there in the future, but not yet."

"Why?"

"Because, uh... by the way, you still have piano lessons to take."

"Okay~."

[Daily performance experience value +5]

Better than nothing.

Ryan was thinking in his mind, but it didn't stop him from turning his head to look at the people of his motherland excitedly.

"Dad, you can fly, you're so awesome!"

Under Beka's uncomfortable expression, which he hesitated to speak, the motherland man put his hands on his hips and said proudly: "Of course, of course I can fly."

"Son, you can actually fly. How about we learn how to fly today?"

"Can I fly too?"
